verdicts.reason: Both reflow into a left-to-right banner, but both break the dash dividers into a stacked 3-line clump of dashes that reads as a glitch, leave 'creativity.' orphaned on a third line, and shrink the phone/website contact block to illegible micro-text jammed at the right edge. A keeps the green tagline on two lines under its own divider and leaves slightly more breathing room. B wraps the tagline into a cramped three-line stack, pushes the body copy against the top edge, and spreads the contact text even thinner and smaller.
